eventView.description: An event record with RSVP counts and URL.

countGoing.description: Number of users who have RSVP'd as going.

countInterested.description: Number of users who have RSVP'd as interested.

countNotGoing.description: Number of users who have RSVP'd as not going.

url.description: The canonical URL for this event on Smoke Signal.

main.description: Get a single event by repository and record key.

recordKey.description: The record key (rkey) of the event.

repository.description: The DID of the repository containing the event.
